title: Exercise confirmed-claim movement during evaluator evidence recovery IO
outcome: A recovery-enabled evaluator on an actual confirmed source claim fails closed when that claim becomes unconfirmed during evidence IO, retaining its original unfinished reason without exposing stale proof.
acceptance: A behavioral control uses an actually confirmed source claim and demonstrates successful recovery when it stays unchanged, then changes claim confirmation during IO and verifies unfinished, recorded=false, no exposed proof, identical no-IO replay and retained reason.
The test passes in a registered committed-input run and adds no text-pinning or Markdown phrase tests.
